title: Life Plan Care Cover on Added Nights of a Respite Stay Extension
content:
**Cover.** The Life Plan care cover on added nights of an extension under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is the care fee discount of the guest's plan, taken as a percentage of the care increase, for a guest who holds an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan or on a fee-for-service plan, and nothing for any other guest.

**Effect on the price of an added night.** The care increase on an added night — the added-night rate less the nightly rate locked at booking — is reduced by the cover, and the price of an added night carries the care increase so reduced on top of the nightly rate locked at booking.

**Records read.** The guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, the contract type of its plan and that plan's care fee discount.

| Guest's Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type | Care fee discount (cover) | Care increase left in the price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Occupied, LifeCare Declining Balance Plan or LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | Lifecare | 100 percent | None |
| Occupied, LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% or 90% Refundable Plan | Fee-for-service | 10 percent | 90 percent of the care increase |
| Not occupied, or not held | — | No cover (0 percent) | The whole care increase |

## Hypothetical illustrations (locked rate 239.00, added-night rate 284.00, care increase 45.00)

- Occupied LifeChoice agreement: care increase 45.00 reduced by 10 percent is 40.50; price of an added night 239.00 plus 40.50, that is 279.50.
- Occupied LifeCare agreement: care increase reduced by 100 percent is nothing; price of an added night 239.00.
- No occupied agreement: price of an added night 239.00 plus 45.00, that is 284.00.
